answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11815 Country: India Title: i have a hotel and apartments for renting. can i give the room to a bank for their clients to stay ? can i rent my apartments to bank for their employees? Question: i have a hotel and apartments for renting. can i give the room to a bank for their clients to stay ? can i rent my apartments to bank for their employees? Answer ID: 11815 Posted on: May 15, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 444/410=B/1430) It is allowed to give one's hotel or apartment on rent to a bank, but since banks do interest based transactions, therefore it is undesirable (makrooh-e-tahrimi). Yes, you can give it to its employees to stay. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
